segments.name: Physical Therapy Operations
products: home-care physical and speech therapy practices
segments.description: Operates outpatient physical, speech and occupational therapy clinics and home-care practices providing pre- and post-operative care and orthopedic rehabilitation for patients.
segments.evidence: Our physical therapy operations segment consists of physical therapy, speech therapy and occupational therapy clinics and home-care physical and speech therapy practices that provide pre- and post-operative care and treatment for a variety of orthopedic-related disorders, sports-related injuries, and rehabilitation of injured workers.

segments.name: Industrial Injury Prevention Services
segments.evidence: Services provided by the industrial injury prevention services ("IIP") segment include onsite services for clients' employees including injury prevention and rehabilitation, performance optimization, post-offer employment testing, functional capacity evaluations and ergonomic assessments.

revenueModel.text: Clinics charge patients and third-party payors for outpatient treatment on a per procedure basis, while IIP services are contracted and paid for directly by employers.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide services at our clinics on an outpatient basis and generally charge for treatment on a per procedure basis.
